hook.name: BorrowedHands
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the ACTION/ETH pool that charges a 0.5% fee on every swap's output, accumulates it as ERC-6909 claims, then autonomously deploys those fees as permanent single-sided liquidity one tick-rung beyond the current price on the side just emptied by the swap, reimbursing the carrying swapper for deployment gas.
